summary: Enhance your skills with our Microsoft Business Intelligence (MSBI) training course. Learn to analyze data effectively and drive business success today!
lede: Microsoft business intelligence training helps analysts, SQL developers, reporting specialists, and database administrators turn source data into dependable reports. It covers profiling data, building SSIS integration packages and dimensional models, and creating DAX measures, Power BI dashboards, and SSRS reports. Learners also examine data quality, access controls, refresh workflows, report validation, and governance to support repeatable reporting for operational and management decisions.
audienceIntro: This Microsoft Business Intelligence course suits professionals who work with organizational data, reporting pipelines, analytical models, or management information and need a structured route from source data to trusted decision support.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with spreadsheets, relational data, and basic business reporting is recommended. Basic SQL SELECT statements are helpful but not mandatory. No programming background is required, although you will use guided SQL, SSIS expressions, and DAX examples. Advanced model engineering, custom application development, and production-scale Microsoft Fabric implementation remain outside the course scope.
